newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares surge 1.14pct on more upbeat mkt mood Greek sh.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares surge 1.14pct on more upbeat mkt mood Greek sh.

text.p: Greek shares extended the New Year's winning streak and rose a strong 1.14 percent in a broad advance and brokers said the market mood was gradually getting more upbeat amid improving fundamentals.

"Banks and construction shares put on a strong performance pulling the index higher," said Yannis Kalogerakis, head of trading at ABN-AMRO Axias Securities. "Sentiment is gradually improving and investors are getting less and less hesitant in buying stocks."

The Athens general share index closed up 1.14 percent or 10.85 points higher at 965.39 points from Thursday's 954.54 points. Turnover was 8.33 billion drachmas on volume of 3.38 million shares, boosted by active block trading.
Gainers led decliners 133 to 67 with 34 shares unchanged on 234 traded.
Bank and construction shares led the advance with the sectoral indexes jumping 1.52 percent and 1.81 percent respectively.
Kalogerakis said falling inflation and interest rates provided a positive backdrop for the oversold bourse that could send it higher.

The December CPI inflation figure is expected to be announced next week. A central bank official told Reuters in early December that inflation would fall to 7.5 percent year-on-year or lower in December from 7.7 percent in November.
The state National Bank of Greece will cut its deposit rates by 50 basis points and its lending rates by 25 to 125 basis points effective January 7, a high-level bank source told Reuters.
